scale: ore_ont_13482 of the ORE 2015 EL sample, GO 2026-07-26 and ChEBI lite 256 on forge, with separate atlas rounds and the laptop's counts and corpus sweep

sides.tip: 89deb60f, e21 and the role table looked up by IRI (Interner::object_role)
sides.clone: 89deb60f with a dropped copy of the IRI at each role found, a layout probe run on atlas only, uncommitted

manifest.build: ~/.local/bin/sparkles-heavy-run 8 mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley, the laptop, mbx 1.29.1, rustc 1.99.1, copied to forge and atlas

settings.pinning: taskset on P-cores of separate physical cores, cpu 2 on one thread and cpus 2, 4, 6 and 8 on four
settings.scope: one process per run in a 12 GiB systemd scope without swap, with a 900 s timeout
settings.lock: the rounds ran under ~/lanes/.bench.lock and ~/lanes/.heavy.lock as the systemd user unit el-index-alloc-ab, alone on the host

method: timing.sh ran nine rounds on forge of the three sides in an order that rotates with the round and thread count, one process per side, file and thread count, with --repeat 5 on ore_ont_13482 and GO and 3 on ChEBI lite. analyze.py takes the median over the rounds of each process's median classification and of its last classification's index time, the ratio of each side to the base and the range of the rounds' ratios. Each line of the log gives the round, the side, the file, the thread count, the exit status, the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the sorted taxonomy and report fields.
